reason: A local conversation-history migration plugin that converts OpenAI Codex sessions into searchable, resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions and optionally groups them into project workspaces.

summaries.zh: 将本地 OpenAI Codex 对话历史转换并导入 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持筛选、断点式重复导入和按项目工作区分组。
summaries.en: Imports local OpenAI Codex conversation history into DeepSeek Harness sessions with filtering, repeat-safe imports, and optional project workspace grouping.

capabilities: Reads OpenAI Codex conversation history from a local Codex directory
Transforms Codex conversation records into DeepSeek Harness session events
Writes imported sessions and workspace associations through DeepSeek Harness persistence interfaces
Supports dry-run and filtering options for scoped imports
